metadata.description: Plugins for Microsoft Discovery (AI for Science): a stable project bundle, labs plugins for skills still being proven, and an everything plugin

plugins.name: discovery-tools
plugins.description: Everything in the discovery-tools catalog for Microsoft Discovery, the AI for Science platform, in one install: the discovery-project-bundle and discovery-flexible-setup plugins plus every labs plugin (discovery-tim-labs, discovery-cape-labs, life-sciences-labs, general-science-labs). Install a single plugin instead if you only need part of it.

plugins.name: discovery-project-bundle
plugins.description: Stable skills for running one Microsoft Discovery project: watch outcome grades and the task board, read engine runs as a chat, report token usage, and gather the project's exhaust (transcripts, logs, telemetry) into the project folder.

plugins.name: discovery-flexible-setup
plugins.description: Set up or re-plan a Microsoft Discovery project with a propose-then-apply workflow: Purpose, data intake into Bookshelf and data/, Outcomes with draft rubrics, task breakdown with human-in-the-loop pauses and compute plans, and agents/skills/tools/A2A agents. Starts from a grant or proposal or walks through step by step; never deletes and keeps a git ledger. Includes pre-flight clarification and agent deployment from microsoft/discovery.

plugins.name: discovery-tim-labs
plugins.description: Experimental Microsoft Discovery skills that are still being tried out: a live operations dashboard, a project-story HTML replay, and a chat-session finder and viewer. Skills graduate to a stable plugin once proven useful.

plugins.name: discovery-cape-labs
plugins.description: Microsoft Discovery task-design skill: generate task designs using the Deterministic, Guided Exploration, and Autonomous Research investigation patterns, and create them as local or cloud tasks.

plugins.name: life-sciences-labs
plugins.description: Life-sciences data skills for Microsoft Discovery projects: SABIO-RK kinetics, licensed BRENDA ingestion, BioCyc/EcoCyc/CyanoCyc network context, version-aware AlphaFold DB retrieval, and Rhea/ChEBI/MetaNetX/UniProt identifier crosswalks.

plugins.name: general-science-labs
plugins.description: Cross-domain science skills: establish an authorized, versioned route to a scientific database, build an auditable evidence and QC layer over merged database evidence, and search DOE literature on OSTI.GOV via the external osti-axi CLI.
